description: This PHP source file defines the class 'bugzillaxmlrpcInterface', which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and provides an implementation for interfacing with Bugzilla via XML-RPC for an issue tracking integration in TestLink. It includes methods for connecting to Bugzilla, retrieving issues and their statuses, creating issues, and managing API communication.

classes.name: bugzillaxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class providing integration with Bugzilla via XML-RPC, allowing issue retrieval, status checking, and issue creation within a TestLink environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration, connects to Bugzilla, and sets default statuses.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes or sets default configuration parameters for the Bugzilla connection.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the initialized API client object.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks whether the bug ID syntax is valid.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Bugzilla server.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Bugzilla has been established.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves an issue object with details like status and summary from Bugzilla.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose, possibly HTML-formatted status string for an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML-formatted summary string for an issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug ID exists on Bugzilla.

methods.name: createAPIClient
methods.description: Initializes the XML-RPC API client for Bugzilla.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides an XML template for configuring the Bugzilla integration.

methods.name: getAccessibleProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products accessible to the authenticated user.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Bugzilla product by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new bug issue in Bugzilla with a given summary and description.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issue creation via API is supported based on configuration.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login to Bugzilla and retrieves a user token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out from Bugzilla, invalidating the user session.
